quotations.old_english: Ðú eall þing birest éðelíce búton geswince
quotations.english: thou bearest all things easily without labour
that thou mayest most easily come

source_text: éðelíce; adv. Easily; fac&i-short;l&i-short;ter:-- Ðú eall þing birest éðelíce búton geswince thou bearest all things easily without labour, Bt. Met. Fox 20, 552; Met. 20, 276. Ðæt ðú mǽge cumon éðelícost that thou mayest most easily come, Bt. 41, 5; Fox 254, 17. v. eáðelíce.
